DECLARE @ApplicableUsers TABLE ( UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
, UserName VARCHAR(MAX) , FirstName VARCHAR(MAX) , LastName VARCHAR(MAX) , MiddleName VARCHAR(MAX)
, UserBackupIntervalId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER , backupStart Datetime , backupEnd Datetime
)
INSERT INTO @ApplicableUsers SELECT u.UserId
, u.UserName , p.FirstName , p.LastName , p.MiddleName
, urb.UserBackupIntervalId , urb.BackupStartDate as backupStart , urb.BackupEndDate as backupEnd
FROM AC_RelUserRole relRole INNER JOIN dbo.AC_User u on relRole.UserId = u.UserId
INNER JOIN People p ON u.userId = p.userId
LEFT JOIN dbo.AC_UserBackupInterval urb on u.userid = urb.userid and getdate() >= (urb.BackupStartDate) AND getdate() < (ISNULL(urb.BackupEndDate, getdate()+1))
getDate()
SELECT u.UserId , as RoleId , NULL AS TeamId , NULL AS TeamName , NULL AS TeamPrefix
, u.UserName , u.FirstName , u.LastName , u.MiddleName
, urbd.BackupUserId as backupID , NULL as backupTeamID , u.backupStart , u.backupEnd , aubk.UserName as BackupUserName , auBk.UserName as UserNameBk , pBk.FirstName as FirstNameBk , pBk.LastName as LastNameBk , pBk.MiddleName as MiddleNameBk
FROM @ApplicableUsers u
LEFT JOIN AC_RelBackupIntervalUserRole urbd on urbd.UserBackupIntervalId = u.UserBackupIntervalId and urbd.BackupUserRoleId = LEFT JOIN ac_user aubk on aubk.userId = urbd.BackupUserId LEFT JOIN people pbk on pbk.userId = aubk.UserId
UNION SELECT u.UserId , as RoleId , T.TeamId AS TeamId , T.TeamName AS TeamName , T.TeamHierarchyPrefix AS TeamPrefix
, UserName , FirstName , LastName , MiddleName
, NULL as backupID , IIF(u.UserBackupIntervalId IS NOT NULL, T.TeamId, NULL) as backupTeamID , u.backupStart , u.backupEnd , NULL as BackupUserName , NULL as UserNameBk , NULL as FirstNameBk , NULL as LastNameBk , NULL as MiddleNameBk
FROM @ApplicableUsers u JOIN DAS_TeamMember_P TM ON u.UserId = TM.UserId JOIN DAS_Team_P (NOLOCK) T ON T.TeamId = TM.TeamId where t.TeamStatusCode = 2
order by u.LastName, u.FirstName

statement.name: getDirectAssignments
statement.sql:
--Getting Rollup for the WorkArea to ParentRole DECLARE @RollupId int, @roleIdParam int
Set @roleIdParam =
SELECT @RollupId = RoleId FROM AC_BureauRoleWorkAreaConfiguration Where WorkAreaId = @roleIdParam
Declare @URWABaseData Table ( ResourceValue Varchar(50), ResourceTypeCode int, RoleId int, UserId uniqueidentifier, TeamId uniqueidentifier ,TeamUnassignedFlag bit ,IsExceptionAssignment bit )
--Check Exception INSERT into @URWABaseData SELECT urwaep.ResourceValue,urwaep.ResourceTypeCode,urwaep.RoleId,urwaep.UserId,urwaep.TeamId ,0 as TeamUnassignedFlag, 1 as IsExceptionAssignment FROM UserRoleWorkAssignmentsException_P urwaep
(@roleIdParam, @RollupId)
IF ((SELECT count(1) FROM @URWABaseData) < 1) BEGIN --Get URWA Base Data INSERT into @URWABaseData SELECT URWA.ResourceValue,URWA.ResourceTypeCode,URWA.RoleId,URWA.UserId,URWA.TeamId ,URWA.TeamUnassignedFlag as TeamUnassignedFlag, 0 as IsExceptionAssignment FROM UserRoleWorkAssignments URWA
(@roleIdParam, @RollupId)
END
SELECT URWA.ResourceValue,URWA.ResourceTypeCode as ResourceType ,URWA.RoleId,URWA.UserId ,URWA.TeamUnassignedFlag as TeamUnassignedFlag ,URWA.IsExceptionAssignment as IsExceptionAssignment ,T.TeamId as TeamId ,T.TeamName as TeamName ,T.TeamHierarchyPrefix as TeamPrefix
, au.UserName as UserName , p.FirstName as FirstName , p.LastName as LastName , p.MiddleName as MiddleName
,cast(urb.backupId as varchar(36)) as backupID , aubk.UserName as UserName ,urb.StartDate as backupStart ,urb.EndDate as backupEnd , auBk.UserName as UserNameBk , pBk.FirstName as FirstNameBk , pBk.LastName as LastNameBk , pBk.MiddleName as MiddleNameBk
from @URWABaseData URWA LEFT JOIN DAS_Team_P T ON T.TeamId = URWA.TeamId
LEFT JOIN ac_user au on au.userId = URWA.userId LEFT JOIN people p on p.userId = URWA.userId
LEFT JOIN UserRoleBackup urb on urwa.userid = urb.userid and urwa.roleid = urb.roleid LEFT JOIN ac_user aubk on aubk.userId = urb.backupid LEFT JOIN people pbk on pbk.userId = urb.backupid
WHERE isnull(au.AccountDisabledDatetime, getdate()+1) >= getDate()

statement.name: getDirectIndirectAssignments
statement.sql:
DECLARE @resourceTypeCode int Set @resourceTypeCode =
--Getting Rollup for the WorkArea to ParentRole DECLARE @RollupId int, @roleIdParam int, @processDetailCodeParam int,@enterpriseProcessCodeParam int
Set @roleIdParam = Set @processDetailCodeParam = Set @enterpriseProcessCodeParam =
SELECT @RollupId = RoleId FROM AC_BureauRoleWorkAreaConfiguration Where WorkAreaId = @roleIdParam
Declare @TempAssignMetaData Table ( Level int, RelatedResourceTypeCode int, RelatedResourceValue Varchar(50), RequireContextFlag bit )
Declare @URWABaseData Table ( Level int, ResourceValue Varchar(50), ResourceTypeCode int, RoleId int, UserId uniqueidentifier, TeamId uniqueidentifier ,TeamUnassignedFlag bit ,IsExceptionAssignment bit )
--Get the AssignmentMetaData
INSERT INTO @TempAssignMetaData select tempHier.Level, tempHier.RelatedResourceTypeCode, T2.Value, tempHier.RequireContextFlag from (select Level, RelatedResourceTypeCode,RelatedColumnName,RequireContextFlag FROM PFM_AMG_AssignmentHierarchyRule WHERE ResourceTypeCode = @resourceTypeCode ) as tempHier join @TempResourceData T2 on tempHier.RelatedColumnName=T2.RelatedColumnName
--Insert the Default Resource INSERT INTO @TempAssignMetaData SELECT 0,@resourceTypeCode, , 0
--Check Exception always at subrole level INSERT into @URWABaseData SELECT TOP 1 * FROM ( SELECT T1.level,urwaep.ResourceValue,urwaep.ResourceTypeCode,urwaep.RoleId,urwaep.UserId,urwaep.TeamId ,0 as TeamUnassignedFlag, 1 as IsExceptionAssignment FROM UserRoleWorkAssignmentsException_P urwaep JOIN @TempAssignMetaData T1 ON T1.RelatedResourcetypeCode = urwaep.ResourceTypeCode AND T1.RelatedResourceValue = urwaep.ResourceValue AND T1.RequireContextFlag = 0 WHERE urwaep.RoleId IN (@roleIdParam, @RollupId) AND urwaep.ProcessDetailCode = @processDetailCodeParam AND urwaep.EnterpriseProcessCode = @enterpriseProcessCodeParam
UNION ALL
SELECT T1.Level,urwaep.ResourceValue,urwaep.ResourceTypeCode,urwaep.RoleId,urwaep.UserId,urwaep.TeamId ,0 as TeamUnassignedFlag, 1 as IsExceptionAssignment FROM UserRoleWorkAssignmentsException_P urwaep JOIN @TempAssignMetaData T1 ON T1.RelatedResourcetypeCode = urwaep.ResourceTypeCode AND T1.RelatedResourceValue = urwaep.ResourceValue AND T1.RequireContextFlag = 1 JOIN UserRoleWorkAssignmentsExceptionContext_P C ON C.UserRoleWorkAssignmentExceptionId = urwaep.UserRoleWorkAssignmentExceptionId AND C.ResourceValueCtx = (SELECT Value From @TempResourceData Where RelatedColumnName = 'ResourceValueCtx') AND C.ResourceTypeCodeCtx = (SELECT Value From @TempResourceData Where RelatedColumnName = 'ResourceTypeCodeCtx') WHERE urwaep.RoleId IN (@roleIdParam, @RollupId) AND urwaep.ProcessDetailCode = @processDetailCodeParam AND urwaep.EnterpriseProcessCode = @enterpriseProcessCodeParam
) TEMP order by level
IF ((SELECT count(1) FROM @URWABaseData) < 1) BEGIN --Get URWA Base Data INSERT into @URWABaseData SELECT top 1 * FROM ( SELECT T1.level,URWA.ResourceValue,URWA.ResourceTypeCode,URWA.RoleId,URWA.UserId,URWA.TeamId ,URWA.TeamUnassignedFlag as TeamUnassignedFlag, 0 as IsExceptionAssignment FROM UserRoleWorkAssignments URWA JOIN @TempAssignMetaData T1 ON T1.RelatedResourcetypeCode = URWA.ResourceTypeCode AND T1.RelatedResourceValue = URWA.ResourceValue AND T1.RequireContextFlag = 0 WHERE URWA.RoleId IN (@roleIdParam, @RollupId)
UNION ALL
SELECT T1.Level,URWA.ResourceValue,URWA.ResourceTypeCode,URWA.RoleId,URWA.UserId,URWA.TeamId ,URWA.TeamUnassignedFlag as TeamUnassignedFlag, 0 as IsExceptionAssignment FROM UserRoleWorkAssignments URWA JOIN @TempAssignMetaData T1 ON T1.RelatedResourcetypeCode = URWA.ResourceTypeCode AND T1.RelatedResourceValue = URWA.ResourceValue AND T1.RequireContextFlag = 1 JOIN UserRoleWorkAssignmentsContext C ON C.UserRoleWorkAssignmentId = URWA.UserRoleWorkAssignmentId WHERE URWA.RoleId IN (@roleIdParam, @RollupId) AND C.ResourceValueCtx = (SELECT Value From @TempResourceData Where RelatedColumnName = 'ResourceValueCtx') AND C.ResourceTypeCodeCtx = (SELECT Value From @TempResourceData Where RelatedColumnName = 'ResourceTypeCodeCtx')
) temp order by Level END
SELECT top 1 URWA.Level,URWA.ResourceValue,URWA.ResourceTypeCode as ResourceType ,URWA.RoleId,URWA.UserId ,URWA.TeamUnassignedFlag as TeamUnassignedFlag ,URWA.IsExceptionAssignment as IsExceptionAssignment ,T.TeamId as TeamId ,T.TeamName as TeamName ,T.TeamHierarchyPrefix as TeamPrefix
, au.UserName as UserName , p.FirstName as FirstName , p.LastName as LastName , p.MiddleName as MiddleName
, cast(urbd.BackupUserId as varchar(36)) as backupID , IIF(urb.UserBackupIntervalId IS NOT NULL, URWA.TeamId, NULL) as backupTeamID , aubk.UserName as BackupUserName , urb.BackupStartDate as backupStart , urb.BackupEndDate as backupEnd , auBk.UserName as UserNameBk , pBk.FirstName as FirstNameBk , pBk.LastName as LastNameBk , pBk.MiddleName as MiddleNameBk
from @URWABaseData URWA LEFT JOIN DAS_Team_P T ON T.TeamId = URWA.TeamId
LEFT JOIN ac_user au on au.userId = URWA.userId LEFT JOIN people p on p.userId = URWA.userId
LEFT JOIN dbo.AC_UserBackupInterval urb on urwa.userid = urb.userid and getdate() >= (urb.BackupStartDate) AND getdate() < (ISNULL(urb.BackupEndDate, getdate()+1)) LEFT JOIN AC_RelBackupIntervalUserRole urbd on urbd.UserBackupIntervalId = urb.UserBackupIntervalId and urbd.BackupUserRoleId = urwa.RoleId and urwa.TeamId is null LEFT JOIN ac_user aubk on aubk.userId = urbd.BackupUserId LEFT JOIN people pbk on pbk.userId = aubk.UserId
WHERE isnull(au.AccountDisabledDatetime, getdate()+1) >= getDate()

statement.name: GetTeamWithMembers
statement.sql:
SELECT t.TeamId, t.TeamHierarchyPrefix + ' - ' + t.TeamName AS TeamName, t.ParentBureauId, t.AssociatedOrgId, u.UserId, u.UserName, p.LastName + ', ' + p.FirstName FullName, CAST(IIF(urb.UserBackupIntervalId IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS BIT) AS RequiresBackup FROM dbo.RelPeopleInternalOrganizations relOrg JOIN People p ON p.PersonId = relOrg.PersonId JOIN dbo.AC_User u ON u.UserId = p.UserId
JOIN dbo.AC_RelUserRole relRole ON u.UserId = relRole.UserId
JOIN dbo.DAS_TeamMember_P mem ON u.UserId = mem.UserId JOIN dbo.DAS_Team_P t ON t.teamId = mem.TeamId LEFT JOIN dbo.AC_UserBackupInterval urb on u.userid = urb.userid AND GETDATE() >= (urb.BackupStartDate) AND GETDATE() < (ISNULL(urb.BackupEndDate, GETDATE()+1))
getDate()
2
order by t.TeamName, u.UserName

statement.name: GetActiveUsers
statement.sql:
SELECT u.UserId , u.Username , p.LastName + ', ' + p.FirstName FullName
, urb.UserBackupIntervalId , urb.BackupStartDate as BackupStart , urb.BackupEndDate as BackupEnd , aubk.UserId as BackupUserId , auBk.UserName as BackupUserName , pBk.LastName + ', ' + pBk.FirstName BackupFullName
FROM dbo.RelPeopleInternalOrganizations relOrg INNER JOIN People p ON p.PersonId = relOrg.PersonId INNER JOIN dbo.AC_User u ON u.userId = p.userId INNER JOIN AC_RelUserRole relRole ON relRole.UserId = u.UserId
LEFT JOIN dbo.AC_UserBackupInterval urb on u.userid = urb.userid and getdate() >= (urb.BackupStartDate) AND getdate() < (ISNULL(urb.BackupEndDate, getdate()+1)) LEFT JOIN AC_RelBackupIntervalUserRole urbd on urbd.UserBackupIntervalId = urb.UserBackupIntervalId and urbd.BackupUserRoleId = LEFT JOIN ac_user aubk on aubk.userId = urbd.BackupUserId LEFT JOIN people pbk on pbk.userId = aubk.UserId
getDate()
order by p.LastName, p.FirstName

statement.name: GetTeamsByUser
statement.sql: select t.TeamId , t. TeamHierarchyPrefix + ' - ' + t.TeamName as TeamName , t.ParentBureauId , t.AssociatedOrgId , u.UserId , u.UserName , p.LastName + ', ' + p.FirstName FullName , cast(IIF(urb.UserBackupIntervalId IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) as bit) as RequiresBackup from dbo.DAS_Team_P t join dbo.DAS_TeamMember_P mem on t.TeamId = mem.TeamId JOIN dbo.AC_User u on u.UserId = mem.UserId INNER JOIN People p ON u.userId = p.UserId LEFT JOIN dbo.AC_UserBackupInterval urb on u.userid = urb.userid and getdate() >= (urb.BackupStartDate) AND getdate() < (ISNULL(urb.BackupEndDate, getdate()+1)) where t.TeamStatusCode = 2 AND t.TeamId IN ( select teamid from dbo.DAS_TeamMember_P where UserId = ) AND isnull(u.AccountDisabledDatetime, getdate()+1) >= getDate()
